We raised a $17 million Series A led by York IE, with participation from Joyance Ventures and our existing investors Aglaé Ventures, Sierra Ventures and Super Angel Fund. We're using it to build the Agent of Record for consumer brands: a platform where agents and the people running the brand work from the same understanding of the customer, and add to it with every interaction.
We started with an empathic customer service agent. The job was simple to describe and hard to do well: understand what a customer needs and do the work to help them. Today we work with hundreds of brands, including SPANX, FIGS, HexClad and Comfrt, and have automated hundreds of millions of customer interactions.
Somewhere along the way, our customers started asking for things that had nothing to do with support tickets. Could Siena plug into their social media tool? Could it help with QA? Could it tell them why returns were up in one category? They were using Siena for support, but they could tell it understood their business, and they wanted that understanding in more places.
